# QuasiPeriodicRamanLattice

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An optical lattice formed by Raman lasers with incommensurate frequencies, creating a quasi-periodic potential for ultracold atoms. Provides a tunable platform for studying topological and localization phenomena relevant to engineered lattice topologies in TCC.
